newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish June car sales up 18.76 percent y/y.
newsitem.headline: Spanish June car sales up 18.76 percent y/y.

text.p: New car sales rose 18.76 percent year on year in June to 94,712 units, provisional data from the National Carmakers' Association ANFAC showed.
The increase in the first half of the year was 10.48 percent to 510,700 units.
Anfac added car sales in 1997 could reach one million units.
"If consumer confidence continues with the (government's) PREVER plan we can reach 1.1 million units or more (this year)," Victor Garcia, ANFAC's general Secretary told journalists.
In May, sales were up 6.89 percent to 88,412 units.
